import struct

# Read the existing test case that's related to hb-shape-fuzzer

print(f"First 64 bytes hex: {data[:64].hex()}")
print(f"First 4 bytes: {data[:4]}")

# Parse OpenType header
if len(data) >= 12:
    sfVersion = struct.unpack('>I', data[0:4])[0]
    numTables = struct.unpack('>H', data[4:6])[0]
    print(f"sfVersion: 0x{sfVersion:08x}")
    print(f"numTables: {numTables}")

        checksum = struct.unpack('>I', data[offset+4:offset+8])[0]
        tbl_offset = struct.unpack('>I', data[offset+8:offset+12])[0]
        tbl_length = struct.unpack('>I', data[offset+12:offset+16])[0]
        print(f"  Table '{tag}': offset={tbl_offset}, length={tbl_length}")
